limits: Bounded Linux/toolchain experiments; no physical target claim.
A successful reference run does not establish independent learner performance.
Source identity and reproducibility do not establish trust in a toolchain.
Hosted C17 profile A permits scalar snprintf, CRT/libc and allocation; core traversal/transaction is original. Native ELF dependencies inspected.
Wrong-type/missing varargs and conflicting modifications are analysis/translation only, never golden-output executions.
16/64-bit promotion models are mathematical changed assumptions, not actual target runs. Native recorded int32/short16/char8 ABI only.
Formatter size overflow is unreachable here: at most4 nonnegative int counts plus NUL fit native size_t64; branch retained for narrower size_t models and reviewed algebraically.
Stable conforming scalar callbacks and nonaliasing live caller buffers are preconditions. Runtime checks cannot prove their provenance.
External review, independent learner and seven-day performance remain unassessed.
